hero.kicker: AN INDEPENDENT CONCEPT BY GIANMARCO BRANDI
hero.title: NAPOLI È PERSONALE.
hero.claim:
ONE MATCH.
MILLIONS OF WAYS TO LIVE IT.
hero.yours: Make it part of your story.
hero.question: WHERE ARE YOU LIVING NAPOLI?
idea.title:
ONE CLUB.
NO TWO STORIES ALIKE.
idea.body: Your connection to Napoli changes with where you are, who you are with and what you want to remember. A digital experience can listen to those differences and return something relevant.
idea.bridge: THREE WAYS TO LIVE THE SAME MATCH.
now.title:
WHAT MATTERS.
WHEN IT MATTERS.
now.body: What you need changes before, during and after a match. Your home can change with it.
now.before.title: PREPARE YOUR RITUAL.
now.before.body: Access information, routes, tickets and official content, only if connected to Club systems. This demonstrates a principle, not an active service.
now.during.title: MAKE ROOM FOR THE MATCH.
now.during.body: A focused match story. Official updates and data only when available from authorized sources; space for the moment you are living.
now.after.title: TAKE THE NIGHT WITH YOU.
now.after.body: Verified content, saved moments and an invitation to build your story. The match ends; the relationship continues.
now.note: PROTOTYPE · NO LIVE MATCH OR CONNECTED SERVICE
card.title:
THE PLACE WHERE YOU
ENTER, LIVE
AND REMEMBER.
card.body: An identity chosen by the supporter. A demonstration card today; in a real product, a possible gateway to preferences and official services, designed with the Club.
card.name: WHAT SHOULD YOUR CARD SAY?
card.demo: DEMO · NO CARD OR MEMBERSHIP HAS BEEN ACTIVATED
card.grows: YOUR MY NAPOLI GROWS WITH YOU.
card.integrations: POSSIBLE CONNECTIONS TO EXPLORE: ACCESS, TICKETING, MEMBERSHIP, MEMORIES.
together.title:
THE MATCH
THROUGH YOUR EYES.
together.body: Not another social network. A place to choose the moment you want to keep; the channels you already use can take it further.
together.demo: ILLUSTRATIVE EDITORIAL MOSAIC · CONTEXT PHOTOGRAPHY WITH CREDITS
together.caption: TELL IT IN ONE SENTENCE
together.caption.placeholder: The detail you want to remember…
together.consent: I would like to propose it for a possible community story
together.consent.note: An optional demo choice. Nothing is sent, published or stored on a server.
together.saved: Your moment is part of this session's story.
together.missing: Write one sentence before saving a moment.
together.workflow: CAPTURE → SAVE → OPT IN, IF YOU WISH → MODERATION → POSSIBLE SELECTION
together.workflow.note: A real product would need verifiable consent, image rights, safeguards for minors, moderation and control over deletion. Publication is never promised.
together.format.note: A possible Club editorial format. Selection and publication would require an official process; this is only a simulation.
together.share.help: An original frame for the channels people already use. No social API is connected.
yours.title:
THE MATCH ENDS.
YOUR STORY DOESN’T.
yours.body: What you choose to save becomes part of your Napoli: a place, a person, a ritual. No invented numbers in place of memories.
yours.subtitle: YOUR SEASON. YOUR STORY.
yours.slide.0.title: YOUR NAPOLI STARTS HERE.
yours.slide.0.body: A name, a perspective, an open story.
yours.slide.1.title: THE PLACES YOU CARRY.
yours.slide.1.body: Your chosen perspective gives a different shape to the same passion.
yours.slide.2.title: YOUR RITUAL.
yours.slide.2.body: The gesture that makes matchday yours.
yours.slide.3.title: THE MOMENTS YOU CHOSE.
yours.slide.3.empty: No moments saved yet. The story begins when you add one.
yours.slide.4.title: THIS WAS YOUR NAPOLI.
yours.slide.4.body: Your story can grow with real moments, not imagined statistics.
yours.disclaimer: A DEMO BUILT ONLY FROM THIS SESSION'S CHOICES. NO CLUB DATA.
loop.title: AN IDEA THAT COMES BACK TO YOU.
loop.steps: DISCOVER → CHOOSE → LIVE → PARTICIPATE → SAVE → REMEMBER → SHARE → BEGIN AGAIN
strategy.title:
A GOOD IDEA
ALSO HAS TO WORK.
strategy.body: Creativity opens the door. Choices, operations and evidence decide whether anyone has a reason to return.
strategy.gtm: HOW I WOULD TAKE IT INTO THE WORLD
strategy.gtm.0.title: TEASER
strategy.gtm.0.body: Different supporters. ‘Their Napoli.’ Then one question: ‘And yours?’
strategy.gtm.1.title: LAUNCH
strategy.gtm.1.body: A clear invitation to create My Napoli, distributed through the touchpoints the Club finds appropriate.
strategy.gtm.2.title: MATCHDAY
strategy.gtm.2.body: A timely question: ‘How are you living Napoli today?’
strategy.gtm.3.title: CONTINUITY
strategy.gtm.3.body: Save a moment, rediscover a story and return without forcing a sale.
strategy.gtm.4.title: END OF SEASON
strategy.gtm.4.body: Il tuo Napoli returns a shareable story and begins another discovery cycle.
strategy.funnel.note: ILLUSTRATIVE NUMBERS, NOT FORECASTS OR SSC NAPOLI DATA. CHANGE THE ASSUMPTIONS TO SEE HOW THE JOURNEY MOVES.
strategy.funnel.denominator: Each step uses the indicated group as its base: shares and moments from created cards; proposals from moments; opens from cards; final shares from opens.
strategy.metrics.body: Acquisition → activation → participation → sharing → return. I would also measure valid content and the path, where useful, towards official Club services.
strategy.metrics.review: ONE QUESTION EACH MONTH: WHAT DID WE LEARN?
strategy.metrics.review.body: Performance, audience, content, community, retention, commercial opportunities, problems and the next experiment. Measure to decide.
strategy.crm.body: Declared, changeable preferences. Different contexts suggest different journeys without fixing a supporter to one label.
strategy.crm.1: DISTANCE: local time, match story, community.
strategy.crm.3: RELATIONSHIP: continuity and relevant services, with consent.
strategy.ops: AN IDEA DOES NOT LIVE ALONE.
strategy.ops.body: Marketing, content, CRM/data, product, ticketing, commercial, privacy and customer care would design it together.
strategy.content: BEHIND EVERY EXPERIENCE IS A SYSTEM.
strategy.content.body: Idea → asset → metadata → rights → localization → approval → publish → measure → reuse. A moment would carry city, language, season, content type, rights and moderation status.
strategy.business.body: Free identity, continuing value and only then possible membership. Ticketing, commerce and partners can support a moment when they add utility. No benefit or commercial relationship is presumed.
strategy.loyalty.body: A first match, a first away trip, a night shared with others: personal chapters, not points that measure a supporter's worth.
strategy.ai: AI IS A TOOL. THE IDEA IS THE WORK.
strategy.ai.body: It can help organize content, localize, prototype and support moderation—with real sources, human oversight, privacy and user choice.
days.title:
BUILD LESS.
LEARN FIRST.
days.0.title: 0–30 / UNDERSTAND
days.0.body: Listen to the team, observe supporter journeys, verify systems, available data and the actual baseline.
days.1.title: 31–60 / PROTOTYPE
days.1.body: Test a small part of NOW, TOGETHER, YOURS and My Napoli with real people.
days.2.title: 61–90 / VALIDATE
days.2.body: Pilot, measure, collect feedback and decide what to improve, extend or stop.
days.truth: I DO NOT YET KNOW SSC NAPOLI'S INTERNAL SYSTEMS, DATA OR ROADMAP. A REAL PROJECT WOULD BEGIN BY LISTENING.
person.reveal:
YOU HAVE SEEN THE IDEA.
YOU HAVE SEEN HOW IT COULD LIVE.
YOU HAVE SEEN HOW I WOULD TEST IT.
person.question: WHO THOUGHT OF ALL THIS?
person.name: GIANMARCO BRANDI.
person.thought:
I DO NOT HAVE ONE STYLE.
I HAVE A WAY OF THINKING.
person.body: I built this concept to show how I start with a question, give it a form and try to turn it into an experience. A real project would begin with the team, real people and real data.
person.closing: IF THIS WAY OF THINKING STARTS A CONVERSATION, THE FIRST STEP IS ALREADY TAKEN.
